# Samantha Provenza, Travel Designer

> Luxury, editorial travel design from a New York-based Fora Travel Advanced advisor. Custom itineraries, group trips, and VIP perks at 4,500+ partner hotels.

Samantha Provenza is a travel designer who plans thoughtful, personally researched trips for couples, families, and groups. As a Fora Travel Advanced advisor, she secures VIP perks like room upgrades, hotel credits, and complimentary breakfast at 4,500+ partner properties. Booking a known hotel is free; custom planning is priced by trip complexity.
